Loss report: gitlab -> drone
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/downstream ext.passthrough (Ext of provider gitlab (trigger) is not written to the Drone file; it is kept in round-trip metadata)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/downstream/step/script step.script (the job has no steps; a no-op step keeps the document valid)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build job.container: default image ubuntu:latest (the job names no image, so steps without one run in ubuntu:latest)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build/step/script step.shell: bash-if-present wrapper command (the source runs the step under bash when the image has it; Drone pipes commands to /bin/sh, so one command re-runs the script under bash -e when the image has bash, else under sh -e, and bash-only syntax fails under sh)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/downstream job.container: default image ubuntu:latest (the job names no image, so steps without one run in ubuntu:latest)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/downstream step.script: no-op step (Drone needs a step; the job has no step to run, so a no-op step stands in)
